contains "Lexis 1", "Lexis 2", "French Verbs", "French Comprehension" and "La France"

This was a software program designed to help students obtain their O-Level French in the UK. However, the year after this software was released the O-Level system was replaced, making the software pretty much obsolete by the time it reached its first year on the market.

192707.overview:
French Military Game is a conversion of an ancient European medieval board game (known as Hare games,. but also under several other names such as Hare and Hounds, Game of Dwarfs, and of course French Military Game, amogs others) for the C64. 

This version was developed by Alan and Martin Gardner and published in the very first issue of Loadstar. Loadstar #001.

193584.overview: Fidgits Music School is an educational music game for children. It was developed by Walter E. Meyers and published in Ahoy! 1986/07 (Issue #31).

194573.overview: A version of the Battleship board game released as part of the "C64/128 Battle Pack".

196854.overview: A SEUCK created shooter designed by Martin Edwards for 1 or 2 users cooperative play and published in Commodore Format 1994/03 (Issue #42).

196976.overview:
The first is a series of three Italian language graphic text adventures from Alessandro Zanello which were all published by Editions Fermont s.r.l. in various issues of Dream magazine, which was an Italian magazine that focused primarily on adventure games.

This one was published in Dream No.1 (11/1985)

196977.overview: The second game in the Felix Hars trilogy from Alessandro Zanello. This was one published just a month after the first game in Dream No.2 (12/1985)

196979.overview: The final game in the Italian graphic text adventure trilogy known as the Felix Hars series. As with the other two, this was was also developed by Alessandro Zanello and published in Dream magazine. This version was also published a month after the second game in Dream No.3 (01/1986).

199303.overview: Your favorite frog is dying of hunger! Help her to swallow the insects, but flee the red fruits ..... indigestible. Published in Hebdogiciel Software N°1

199401.overview: Flipper is a German language pinball game developed in BASIC, and controlled via the keyboard. It was developed by Andreas von Lepel and published in CHIP-Special: Commodore 64 Programme #3.

199438.overview: An early Yar's Revenge clone for one or two users by Thierry Loulergue. In this sad time where even insects go to war with the most modern means, flies have only one goal: The destruction of bees and their hives. Published in both Hebdogiciel Hors Serie N°2 magazine, and Hebdogiciel Software N°1.

199442.overview: Live the horrors of FLOYD the robot, responsible for overseeing the integrity of a database, endlessly threatened by ignoble bugs, sparks and other locks. A game created by Paul Hammond & Maxime Frenot and published in both Hebdogiciel Hors Serie N°2, and Hebdogiciel Software N°3.

199554.overview:
Five by Five is a solitaire card game developed by Maurice Jones and published in Loadstar #188. Maurice's latest solitaire Rotato game is fast, tricky and one you wouldn't want to play with real cards.  The inspiration for the name is from the swing song:
 
Mr. Five by Five
He's five feet wide
   and five feet high
He's a mellow old cat,
   a real hip cat.
He's Mr. Five by Five.

200139.overview: Factoring by Decomposition is a math game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by J.B. Nicholson and published by Commodore Educational Software in 1982

200618.overview:
A variant version with improved music and graphical elements. Also a new tape version is available. 

An evil Dictator has risen. A new war has taken place in the Gulf of Mexico. He threatens to start a worldwide Nuclear war, which could result to devastating consequences. The president sent in many of the armed forces to do battle against the evil dictator. Although weakening  the enemy forces was going well at first, nobody survived. In order to win the nuclear war. A code has been broken, and intelligence has detected that the dictator is located at an unused airport at the other side of the warzone The president has called in the Flying Cobra pilots... Unfortunately this is where you take the piece of the action.

The Game
Your mission is to pilot Flying Cobra fighter jets (using a joystick in port 2) across the enemy lines. Your plane is armed with forward rockets, and also guided missile launchers. To fire the guided missile launcher, you must move the direction of the plane and fire whilst in motion. You must fight against all enemies that are located on ground, air and sea. During the battle you will be under firing range - which is very easy for the enemies. Some enemies will aim for the current position of your jet and then when ready, they will fire. Try to avoid the enemy fire.

Later on in the game, you will find your plane's altitude is getting critically low. During that stage crashing into any buildings, otherwise you'll waste one of the jets. If all jets are wasted, the game is up and the dictator wins. Can you survive, land safely at the airport and finally get dictator arrested? Or will the nuclear war break out across the world? The fate is in your hands.

202190.overview:
An educational game in which you play a firefighter who must put out a fire in a burning building by correctly answering math problems. This was developed by Andy van Duyne and published in the following:

•   COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1988/02 (Issue #56)
•   Best of Gazette 1988 (Disk Issue)

202191.overview:
A well-made homebrewed conversion of the Nintendo Game and Watch game of the same name. Move the trampoline to catch the jumpers as they leap from the burning building.

This was developed in 2020 by Nick Sherman (better known as Arlasoft) and released on his itch.io page.

203228.overview:
Not to be confused with the more well known C64 game of the same name by Codemasters, Fast Food is actually an unofficial conversion of the 1982 Atari 2600 game by Telesys. This conversion was developed by Arlasoft (Nick Sherman) and published on his itch.io page in 2021.

How To Play:

Simply move the mouth around the screen eating as much food as possible, while AVOIDING THE PURPLE PICKLES. If you eat six of these, it's game over. 

Some foods are worth more calories than others, and unlike the original the developer has added double scoring for items travelling at higher speeds to encourage some risk taking. After every 30 or so items eaten you will get fatter and the speed of the game will increase. 

Compatible with PAL and NTSC machines.

204135.overview: A German language Educational game focusing on spelling.

205387.overview:
An amphibian themed logical/brain game released as part of the following as part of Wicked Software's Big 100 Collection. Also released as part of Robtek's King Size compilation.

Dutch and German translated versions also exist. The German version is still called Frogs 64 (released in Tiger-Crew-Disk #072 (03/2000), but the Dutch version was released under the name Kikkers. Unlike the English and German versions however, the Dutch version does not have a title screen.

205388.overview:
A fairly basic implementation of a fruit machine game developed by Bill Russell and published as a type-in listing in the following:

-   Commodore Computing International v02-06 (Oct 1983) 
-   The book "CBM 64 Programs - Volume 1" 
 
This is a simple fruit machine game. It incorporates nudges, holds, and sound effects. Each symbol is represented by a string of three characters.

205389.overview: This fruit machine game implementation was developed by Clifford and Mark Ramshaw and published by Melbourne House in 1983 as a type-in listing from the book "Commodore 64 Games Book".

205390.overview: Fruit Nudger is a fruit machine simulation for the Commodore 64. This game was developed by Barry Joynes and self-published in 1986.

205391.overview:
Fruit Tree is a simple, but hard-as-nails "catch-it" style game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Peter Marino (coding) and John Mikkelsen (Graphics) and published in TAST! 1987/04.

Move your pick-up track back and forth and collect various fruit such as lemons and cherries falling from the tree.

206636.overview:
A Football/Soccer arcade style game for 2 players for head to head competitive play. First published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1986/02 (Issue #32), and later in Best of COMPUTE! & Gazette,  Digital Marketing PD #146 and by Australia's Street Games as part of the "Red Pack". Later it would be re-released as Fresh Kicker by Tiger-Crew PD.  There's no such thing as luck in this fast-paced two-player soccer simulation for the Commodore 64 and 128 (in 64 mode). Two joysticks are required. 
 
Defense is just as important as offense in "Kicker," a two-player soccer simulation in which each player controls nine men. You need quick reflexes to protect your goal and to drive the ball toward your opponent's goal.

206924.overview:
Fur is a conversion of an old game for the Altair 8800 (late 70's computer) to the C64.  The original was developed by Marge Kosel, and the C64 conversion was done by Barry "Cout" Hart in 2005.

In this text based trading game, you are a French fur trader. You have 190 pelts (in total per round) of four different kinds (Mink, Beaver, Ermine, and Fox) to trade at three specific trading forts. Fort 1 (Fort Hochelaga in Montreal) being the easiest (the quickest way to gather some $ before trying the harder trading posts), Fort 2 (Fort Stadacona in Quebec City) being harder, and finally Fort 3 (Fort New York), being the hardest.

208010.overview:
Fechten is a German language fencing game for 2 players only. It was developed by Stefan Redlinger and published in Homecomputer 1984/06. 
There will be a planche. two counting columns, some spectators and the 2 fencers are shown. The point of the game is to hit the opposing fencer as often as possible without being hit yourself. The fencers are controlled using Joystick.
 
Each player can place his fencer in three different positions. In the basic position on the stitch position (push the lever up) and into the defense position (push the lever down). A hit is only possible if a player in trick position hits a player in starting position. If a player in trick position attacks another player and that player still earns a strike before being hit. go into a defensive position, the attacker is practically disarmed. i.e. it automatically goes into the basic position. 

Now this is the big chance for him defending player to land a hit. by going into the stitch position with lightning speed and trying. to hit the unwalled attacker. Two players meet in trick position. the computer reports “Action Simultaneous”, i.e. neither player receives a point. If there are other clashes between the 2 players (e.g. one player in basic position and the other in defensive position), nothing happens.

208447.overview:
It is raining heavily outside your house, and the object of this game is to catch the falling raindrops before they fall down through the roof - depicted by the yellow line - and into the basement below. Once raindrops reach the basement, it starts to fill up with water. When the bucket is nearly full, you need to go to the sink at the right of the roof to empty it. Once you have caught enough raindrops, you proceed to the next level but the water level in the basement remains the same. The game ends if the basement is completely flooded.

Developed by Tony Brantner and originally published in Ahoy! 1987/11 (Issue #47).

It was also released by CP Verlag in Magic Disk 64  1988/06.

208579.overview:
A collection of BoulderDash games, No One's Boulder, BoulderHead and Final Boulder Dash, created by No One and using the updated BoulderDash Construction Kit. 

Includes:
BoulderDash 1
BoulderDash 3-11
BoulderHead 1-3
No One's Boulder1-18
Final Boulder

Thanks to updated BD Compression, all this on a single disk!

208601.overview:
Firefighter Jenny is a "climber" game in which you have to climb buildings and extinguish fires. This game was developed by Daniel "Oziphantom" Hotop WITH Saul Cross doing the graphics. This was released as part of the 2016 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition.

Watch our for the birds, they will attack you.

208602.overview: Not to be confused with the ZX Spectrum game of the same name, Fireflash for the C64 is a 1995 homebrew attempt at a Commando or Rambo inspired shooter made using the Shoot Em Up Construction Kit. It has up to 2 players co-op. This one was developed by Andrew Hickie.

208603.overview:
Firefighter Mario is a Vanguard clone, with Mario in a firetruck – having to put out fireball enemies, and then destroy a large flame on top of a building. The game scrolls in a variety of directions, just like Vanguard. It’s not the best game in the world, but for 1983 and 4K, you cannot really complain!

The game was developed by Jeremy Thorne and scheduled to be published by Mr. Computer Products in 1983, but was cancelled due to concerns over legal action from Nintendo.

208605.overview:
Fireflies is a weird "catch it" game for the Commodore 64. Try to catch all the fireflies in the jar.

The game was developed by Daniel Tobias in 1984, and published in Loadstar #004.

208643.overview: An entrant in the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition, this horizontally scrolling space shooter was created by Megastyle, and published by Reset Magazine.

208651.overview: Featuring the same game play style as the original Defender but with a more military theme, you must fly your aircraft back and forth destroying UFO's and bombing ground targets. Lots of fun, contains an intro, musics, a lot of levels, an end sequence, and is available as either PAL or NTSC.

210266.overview: Fold'em 2 is the successful successor to Fold'em. Just like the first part, Fold'em 2 is a traditional 2D top-down puzzle game with more colors and improved graphics than his predecessor. Each of the 100 levels presents numerous tiles, which must be removed one-by-one to progress. The catch is that once a tile is gone, there is no going back on it, so you must carefully plan the fastest and safest route. The game starts simple and slowly introduces more puzzle elements as you go. In the further course you will also come across other tiles - such as teleporters or those that can be entered twice or only in one direction.

210267.overview: Flangry Bird 101 is an arcade-style game in which the player controls the bird Flangry, which moves persistently to the right. The player is tasked with navigating Flangry through pairs of pipes that have equally sized gaps placed at random heights. Flangry automatically descends and only ascends when the player taps the spacebar. Each times passes the player is awarded points. Colliding with a pipe or the ground ends the gameplay. The game gets faster when a lever is completed.

210385.overview: An update to the venerated Sublogic Flight Simulator II that was released in 1984 in combination with the more recent Master's XXL version. This release has enhanced and expanded scenery selections. It fixes the frequency display issues normally seen in the original game and makes the game much more enjoyable and playable.

210799.overview: RoboVox: Fish Pond (alternatively known as Fish Pond: RoboVox) is a shoot em up developed by Pinov Vox using the Shoot 'em Up Constriction Kit. The game was released as part of the 2020 SEUCK Competition. The main protagonist is somewhat inspired by the James Pond character from the James Pond series of platformers.

213273.overview:
Farming Simulator ( also called Farming Simulator 19: C64 Edition) is a version of Farming Simulator made for the C64. Originally part of Farming Simulator 19 (Collector's Edition) it is also available separately as a download which this entry covers as well as a separate boxed physical cartridge release. For Windows the game is played on the VICE emulator. It contains the CRT and D64 files needed to run it and these can also be used separately to play the game on the original C64 hardware.

The game has the typical Farming Simulator gameplay here shown from an isometric perspective. There are three tractors and one harvester the player can control, based on the brands Case IH, Fendt, John Deere and New Holland. The game takes place on a single map. The different vehicles can be controlled and there are keys to quickly switch between them. Basic actions are acceleration, turning, breaking or reversing, and using the equipment. The vehicles also have a separate key to use the horn.

The game was added to the carousels on theC64 and theC64 Mini in the 2019 firmware update.

213318.overview:
Why did the chicken cross the road? 

Freeway is a two player only game for the Commodore 64, and an unofficial conversion of the Activision Atari VCS/2600 game of the same name. It was developed by Nick "Arlasoft" Sherman and released on his itch.io page in 2021. 

Game Description:

In Freeway, your job is to help the chicken cross the road! Each time you successfully guide the chicken across ten lanes of freeway traffic, you earn a point. Try to score as many points as you can by the end of the 2 minute 16 second time limit! In the two player game, whoever scores the most points by the end wins. Several game variations are included which can adjust the speed and amount of traffic on the freeway.

213587.overview:
Frostviken is a single-player text-based board game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Tim Hartnell and Nathan Butcher and published as a type-in game in the book "Second Giant Book of Computer Games" in 1985. 

The game's name comes from a city in Norway of the same name.

215277.overview: A puzzle game by Mark Neesam released in Zzap!64 Megatape #20 and in Starlight Magazine #5.

215278.overview:
Flock is a clone of Satan’s Hollow, and borrows graphics from the original game and various sprites, music and routines from other titles. The result is an original game though where you must shoot down flocks of birds.

Francesco built the game in assembly, possibly with some in compiled BASIC. It’s a simple but fun shooter which was typical of the games found on the Italian compilation tapes that were so popular.

215279.overview: Flower-Cubes is a Tetris style game with music by Vulgarik, released in 1996.

215280.overview: A text adventure with graphics created by Alex Grant and released by Satchel Software in 1989. Classic educational adventure game it comes with software, teacher's guide, story book, map and audio cassette.

215281.overview: A wacky Italian climbing game from Roberto Negro, it was translated to English in the 2020 update. Climbing in the United States and the art of climbing skyscrapers. Our friend climbs up trying to avoid everything, as best he can, the colleagues who fall from above, the jars of the mischievous child and the flower pots as well as the cats. Be careful not to leave your hands in the windows. It hurts!

215282.overview: A one or two player Simon style memory game created by Bob Steward with C64 translation by Jim Wieder and released by Carousel Software in 1983.

215299.overview: A Sci-fi shooter created by Jim Butterfield using SEUCK. Loops to the start after completing. Take out the turrets, the laser emplacements, the spheres of death. and all manner of craft trying to take you out. Rescue the humans from as deep in the complex as you dare!

215302.overview: Published in the Reset #10 Mix-i-Disk, K&A plus #12, bonus game on "Digiloi" tape. This cool platform shooter features massive sprites and cool PETSCII graphics. Infiltrate Fort DJango, fighting your wan through the two zones and battling the relentless enemies.

215303.overview: An interpretation of the ancient board game that dates back to the 14th century. It was developed by David Zimmat and published in Loadstar #166 in 1998.

215304.overview: On a freeze-ing Christmas Eve, help Santa deliver presents in Chimneys while avoiding obstacles! How many points can you score before the night is over? A game by Mike and Aurora Richmond.

216378.overview: Factor Factory is an educational math game from Australia that quizzes the player on factors. It was developed and published by Little Red Hen Software in 1986. It is a collection of three mini-games: Factory, H.C.F., and El See-Em.

216724.overview:
Flappy Night is a clone of Flappy Bird with some original gameplay elements for the Commodore 64, done in a Halloween setting. The goal is to fly until it reaches daytime. 

The game was developed by Digital Monastery (the game development division of cracking/demoscene group Hokuto Force), and released into the public domain on October 31, 2022.

217340.overview: Flipper Pong is a 2 player only French language Pong clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Michel Girboux and published in Hebdogiciel on the front page of N°041 (20.07.1984). Here is a Ping-Pong containing obstacles and a Bumper Central, original isn't it? For two players with joysticks..

218683.overview: An area of 15000 square miles is incorporated into this combat flight simulation from specialists Digital Integration. A full cockpit view is recreated, including gauges for airspeed and vertical speed. You can take off, land and shoot it out, with full practice modes on offer. Blind flying, cross winds and air turbulence are modelled accurately and can be used for a more advanced flying experience. A map is built in, as is full recreation of the targeting facilities of a F15.

218792.overview:
Feuer-Springer is a German language clone of the old Nintendo Game & Watch game, Fire. It was developed by Hannes Malecki and published by Welle:Erdball (which is Malecki's own personal label) in 2002.

It's keyboard controlled only.

219784.overview: Drive your F1 Car along the Track and avoid Hazards and Other F1 Cars, Pick up Spanners and Gas Cans for Bonus Points and to get on the Hi-Score table.

219786.overview: C64 Game Competition at SEUCK Game Creation Compo 2016

219790.overview: Try to find your Business Partner in a Building with 9 Floors. You can go by Lift by pressing the Number of the Floor. But be careful ... you can also crash & lose your precious life!

219848.overview: Full Screen Snake is a single-player snake game that actually allows the player to play in the C64 borders by drawing the background sprites into the border itself. The game was developed by Diego Barzon and released into the public domain in 2017.

219879.overview: Easily the most popular and successful foreign language learning programs of all time. Complete with extensive vocabulary files which may be extended or modified indefinitely by users. The French Mistress (Level B) contains verbs, adjectives, adverbs, phrases and the like. It is a perfect compliment to the (Level A) tha that contains thousands of nouns.

220124.overview:
A ranger has to do a lot of work to preserve the forest. He has to take care of the loggers, the industries that want to pollute the lakes, and the arsonists who wants space for their pastures.

Use the joystick in port 2 to walk around and scare the villains before they can finish cutting off a tree, pollute the water, or burn bushes.

228213.overview: Subtitled as "The Fishing-Trip (Brown Trout and Goblins)". Written with PunyInform V1.8. If you are a fan of Fuddo and Slam then here is a little romp for you to enjoy - hopefully. The game was actually written to illustrate the option in 'PunyInform' to change between the main characters and thereby utilize their individual talents ... not that Slam has much more than his love of food and breaking things. In this game we follow the two "boggits" Fuddo and Slam (many of John Wilson's games take place in a parody world based on Tolkien's universe). Roughly speaking, this game is a treasure hunt. I don't want to reveal much, as part of the game is figuring out what the objective is from some subtle clues in various locations. You can get 230 points maximum, but not all points are required. Also, expect a few maze-like locations.

417645.overview:
A game attributed to John Patrick Green but bearing an uncanny resemblance to the German game Mensch ärgere Dich nicht which came out five years earlier, which was made by Ralf Hahn, this game was published in ReRun Special Summer Edition 1990. 

FRANTIC!, BASED ON the popular board game Parcheesi, is a game of excitement and strategy for both children and adults. By rolling a die you must move the four pawns of your color from square to square around the playing board until they eventually reach home base. Sound easy? Well, as you're moving your pawns, other players will be trying to land on them and remove them from the board, so your pawns must start over again. 

To play Frantic!, first load and run the boot program, then, at the prompt, press return to load and run the main program. When the title screen appears, press the space bar to specify the number of players (computer and/or human), their colors and, if human, their names. There can be one to four players with the colors yellow, blue, green and red. For the first game, I suggest you have all four computer players play against each other, to see how the game goes. (You might not want to watch the whole game, because it can take up to an hour for the computer to defeat itself.) 

The player with the highest number rolls first, then the others take turns clockwise around the board. The computer rolls automatically, but people must press the space bar to roll the die. You get three rolls of the die per turn until you roll a six, which places one of your pawns on the starting arrow of your color. This ends your turn, and on subsequent turns you get only one roll, unless all your active pawns get bounced from the board, you make it to home base, or you roll another six. Then you get three rolls per turn again until you roll six and another pawn goes to the starting arrow.

417742.overview: A Zzap 64! Micro Action C64 community-based covermount title (Issue #13 - March/April 2023). This game has participated in Retro Programmers Inside's Racing Cars game jam, to be streamed in late February by Prince/Phaze101 via Twitch & YouTube. It was programmed in Kick Assembler V5.25, with aid of CBMPRGStudio V4.0. For Speed We Need 3 is a fun hi score challenge game. You have entered the RB Le Mans challenge. Your task is to complete and also survive all 24 laps. This may sound pretty much simple, but there are enemy cars charging towards you from the front. The opponents will not stop for anyone either! You score points by travelling distances. Also, if you complete a lap, you will be awarded a bonus of 1,000 points, plus an extra life. Time, low fuel and damage to your car are your enemies and you only have a few lives.

417972.overview: A shoot'em up created by Black Turk and released in 2007 at the 7D7 Demo Party.

417992.overview:
In this 1990 beat'em up, the future NYC has become inhospitable and depraved, with thugs lining every street waiting to pounce on ordinary civilians. Thankfully Freddy Hardest is on hand to face up to the baseball bats and knives, in a side-scrolling beat 'em up game.

421103.overview:
Operate a fun fair for profit! Design and run your dream theme park. Research new attractions, facility improvements etc. Hire staff to help the park run smoothly. Manage stock levels, negotiate pay rises with staff union.  acquire loans to pay for improvements. Set ticket, shop and stall prices
    Beat the competition with a profitable and happy park. Choose from a number of difficulty levels Click on the park gates to open to the public. Place rides etc. before paths as they have a less flexible grid system than paths. The save button is disabled and the settings button takes you to the wage negotiation screen in this unfinished version.

    32 rides and animal attractions
    20 shops and gaming stalls
    16 features and toilet facilities

421168.overview: A single player Flappy-Bird inspired game where you use your immense flatulence to fly through multiple types of hazards to proceed ever onward. Released at X'2023!

424433.overview:
Dive into a world of mind-bending challenges with "FiZZ," the innovative platform puzzle game for the Commodore 64. Test your wits and coordination as you explore 40 captivating single-player levels and 30 cooperative multiplayer puzzles. 

Key Features:

    Gravity-Defying Gameplay: In "FiZZ," you have the power to switch gravity using gravity pods in all four directions. Outsmart laser obstacles with this unique mechanic.
    Portal-Shooting Action: Harness the laser-powered portals to navigate through intricate mazes. Strategically place portals, use mirrors, and solve complex puzzles in both single-player and cooperative modes.
    Varied Difficulty: Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or new to the genre, "FiZZ" offers a wide range of challenges, from brain-teasing puzzles to more accessible levels suitable for all players.
    Coop Mode: Team up with friends for an cooperative gaming experience. Coordinate your gravity-defying abilities and portal-shooting skills to conquer the cooperative levels. You can play the coop levels also as single player.
    Pay homage to the classic C64 era while delivering a unique gaming experience. 

Get ready to flip, twist, and strategize your way through a puzzle-packed adventure like no other. "FiZZ" brings a new dimension to puzzle gaming, where creativity and logic intersect in a gravity-defying world.

You can switch from side to side to avoid them and must try to go as deep as possible. Freudtastic! To make things more difficult you must control 2 sliders in different tunnels at the same time!

Note, you can only catch meatballs with the meatball basket and must drop the basket to catch the teachings. Be touched by his blessed noodly appendage!

452222.overview:
"RobCo Industries Termlink procol" is the way you can hack Fallout's terminal (at least in Fallout 3 and 4, I don't know if also in others).

This is a little transposition of that game, made in Basic V2 for Commodore 64 (with just a little help of ASM for some scroll effects).

There are plenty of words, all 7 letters long for easyness, generated by ChatGpt in order to save time.

Enjoy your training in hacking terminals, so that you can be stronger when playing that in Fallout!

Use cursor arrows to move in the hackish screen and to select the word to test (by pressing return)

Basic source code included, intended for CBM prg studio.

452294.overview: The caverns are invaded with ice monsters. In order to keep them away all the fireplaces need to be lit. You are a young wizard tasked with this job. Pick up fire from an active fireplace by jumping at it and bring it to another one, press fire to extend the flames away from you. you can hold a maximum of 4 flames. Once you light all the fireplaces you move to the next level. Flames will temporarily melt ice when they make contact. Be careful not to fall into the endless depths.Released as part of the Craptastic  games competition 2024.

452645.overview: Fruit Hoot is a simple public domain fruit machine game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by A. Millet and released on Github in 2024.

452664.overview:
An Italian language collect'em-up created in 1984. Romeo , the protagonist of our game, is the victim of a spell cast on him by the old witch of the woods, since some time ago he had collected magical seedlings destined for mysterious spells. To free himself from the spell that oppresses him, Romeo must go through eight enchanted gardens that separate him from the wall beyond which he will find salvation. 
 
During this adventurous and dangerous journey he must collect all the lucky charm plants he encounters in his steps, while avoiding the poisonous ones planted by the witch in his path. But his escape is also hampered by horrendous monsters who relentlessly pursue him, and if that weren’t enough he must avoid falling into the many bewitched wells.

453484.overview:
It is the hour of the wolf.
You enter the dark forest.
Something moves among the trees...
Stay on the narrow path
and aim well...

Game produced for Halloween 2024.

Use the alligator to assist Florida Man in escaping aliens, giant pythons, and porta-potties.  Find all nine artifacts to unlock the final battle with Zadron the alien boss.

480885.overview: Fablephobia: The Borrowed Morning is a short graphic adventure for the Commodore 64. Explore a strange sleeping house as Alice follows traces of Pippa through mirrors, forgotten rooms and a moonlit well.

481000.overview:

Pippa's little wolf is missing.
Follow its trail through the strange woods of Fablephobia, investigate unsettling places, question suspicious inhabitants and choose carefully what Pippa should do next.

As your plane flys across the screen, you can drop bombs onto the numbers in the rocky cavern below. 482921.overview: race down an endless scrolling ski slope against the clock, through forests and slalom gates.
